found.cancellationPolicy: At LAND AESTHETICS, we kindly request a 24-hour notice for any cancellations. Should you need to cancel within this time frame, a charge of 50% of the scheduled service will be charged . For no-show or no-call appointments, the full 100% of the service fee booked will be charged and a deposit will be required to rebook. This policy is in place to respect both our time and the ability of other clients to receive their desired services. Your understanding and cooperation are greatly appreciated.
